from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyConstructionRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single monthly data point extracted from a statistical release."""
    month: str | None = Field(description="The time period the data represents in YYYY-MM format")
    permits_nsa: float | None = Field(description="Total building permits (Not Seasonally Adjusted), in thousands of units")
    completions_nsa: float | None = Field(description="Total housing completions (Not Seasonally Adjusted), in thousands of units")
    report_release_date: str | None = Field(description="The date this release was published (YYYY-MM-DD) to determine precedence")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    construction_data_points: list[MonthlyConstructionRecord]
